clips.title: The story
paras: Pridewing Venom Sacs are harvested from the lethal wyverns nesting around Mirkfallon Lake in the Stonetalon Mountains. The night elves of Astranaar seek to stockpile and destroy these sacs after intelligence suggests Horde operatives harvest the potent poison for covert assassinations.

The pridewings of Stonetalon are dangerous, airborne predators native to the peaks south of Ashenvale, particularly around Mirkfallon Lake. While wild wyverns are naturally venomous, Alliance intelligence out of Theramore suggests that Horde assassins have begun milking them for poison to coat blades used in covert raids against night elf settlements. To safeguard their kin and disrupt enemy supplies, the Sentinels in Astranaar hire scouts to hunt down the beasts and collect the venom glands before the Horde can secure them.
